fixed: phrases.opening: removed the added 'Hello,' so the sentence holds only what P16 1 requires (automated assistant of Bank 6, call is recorded); still opening_verbatim=false because the words are not dictated.
phrases.today_question: changed 'Can you pay this today?' to 'Can you pay all of it today?' to match the P16 18 wording.
phrases.cannot_answer_sentence: removed the added apology so it says only what P16 32 requires ('say you could not record it').
Source spans extended (identity, callback, third party, multi_product, phrases, promise_write, outcomes) to quote the rules each value comes from (P16 3, 5, 7, 30, 36, 19 naming).
unresolved: Wrong-answer limit: M46 says 5 in total, but the API summary says three wrong answers end the check. Kept 5 from the memo; the API's wrong_answers_left may end the check sooner.
Human request during the identity check: P16 15 transfers at once, while M46 D says to ask once first and does not separate the phases. Ask-once-first is applied to every human request.
The API says get_account is refused until 'both questions' are passed, but the documents require three security questions. Kept the three from the documents.
Hardship: the documents ask for one short sentence of sympathy without giving the words, so the sentence used is written, not quoted.
